The union of the Who's On First region records Waterford (85684953), Cork (85684963), Limerick (85684987), Kerry (85684991), Clare (85685037), Tipperary (1159294375). A record is assigned to the first-level division GeoNames files the populated places inside its boundary under. For each of the 26 records, at least 99 percent of those places are under one division.
